subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollover reuse an existing reset hook contract, add a new internal session:reset event, or expose both through one canonical lifecycle service?
rationale: Current main has separate typed plugin and internal hook systems, and choosing event names, ordering, transcript visibility, and compatibility behavior is a public extension-contract decision rather than a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Canonical reset lifecycle
options.body: Introduce one lifecycle service that emits typed before_reset and a generic internal session reset event for every reset reason without inventing command actions.

options.title: Extend before_reset only
options.body: Fire the existing typed plugin before_reset hook for daily and idle rollover and keep internal HOOK.md automation unchanged.

options.title: Reuse command events
options.body: Emit command-style daily or idle reset events so session-memory can be widened with minimal new API surface, accepting the command/lifecycle semantic mismatch.

recommendation.title: Canonical reset lifecycle
recommendation.body: Introduce one lifecycle service that emits typed before_reset and a generic internal session reset event for every reset reason without inventing command actions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership signals cover both session-memory and hooks, and the active implementation already requests this owner's review.
